entry.name: Todo
entry.summary: A todo list in the right rail, kept between runs.

description: A todo list you can keep in the right rail. It stores its items in the plugin's own data directory, so they survive a restart and a disable/enable cycle.
readme:
Todo is the smallest useful plugin: one panel, one list, one file.

Add an item with the field at the top, tick it off, filter by All / Active / Done, and clear the finished ones. The list is written to `vibex-settings.json` in the plugin's data directory.

It asks for `ui.panel` (a place in the right rail) and `storage` (a file of its own), and nothing else.
